name: Pre-registration
test: The rule, its parameters and its bet class were written down before any result was inspected, with the commit that froze them.

name: Minimum sample
test: At least 300 graded, non-pushed bets in the certification universe.

name: Price provenance
test: Every graded bet links to a verified opening AND closing price snapshot in the price store with a UTC timestamp.

name: Out-of-sample only
test: Each bet was produced by parameters fitted strictly before the period graded.

name: Beats the price
test: Hit rate beats the break-even rate at the graded price, two-sided exact binomial, Holm-adjusted across the families.

name: Deflation
test: Deflated Sharpe ratio >= 0.95 against 8 pre-registered families.

name: Economic realism
test: Edge survives the documented -110 grading convention and a stated limit on stake size; no claim of unlimited liquidity.

name: Correlation audit (parlays / prop combos only)
test: Every leg pair has a published joint estimate from an official source, or the family is refused.  Independent pricing of correlated legs is not permitted.

name: Certification universe is official
test: The bets being certified were graded against results from an official publisher, not a mirror.
